render.tilesManifestPrelude:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GROUP E — Win9x / DOS / OS/2: PS/2-only (usb=off), Sound Blaster 16 (only
#           inbox codec that works), acpi=off/kernel-irqchip=off, legacy
#           -cpu pentium*. rel/warpd pointer. ALL VERBATIM (golden fixtures).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# win311 (VMID 90) — Windows 3.11, sb16, two golden qcow2 disks (tile-local,
#   NO -snapshot; savevm/loadvm 'golden' persists). VERBATIM LAUNCHER with the
#   COM1 serial chardev (serial.sock) for the in-guest agent.
# POINTER=warpd (hybrid): usb=off => PS/2 RELATIVE-only mouse, and the Win3.x
# DOS mouse driver applies acceleration so an abs->rel bridge desyncs. Fix
# (guest-agents/win311/agent.c): an in-guest Win16 agent OpenComm("COM1")s and
# SetCursorPos()es the cursor absolutely from the warpd M/P/R/B protocol over
# COM1. SH_WARPD_BUTTONS=qemu keeps MOTION on the agent but routes BUTTONS
# through the real QEMU PS/2 device for true window-manager semantics. The COM1
# device comes from machine 'pc'; -serial chardev:ser0 only redirects its
# BACKEND so the guest device set is UNCHANGED and loadvm golden still matches.
# LAG+DRAG FIX (baked 2026-07-08): AGENT.EXE coalesces moves per COM1 drain
# batch; the two-channel race is closed by SH_WARPD_BUTTON_DELAY_MS=80 with
# SH_WARPD_PACE_MS=8 write pacing (empirical floor 50; 80 = 0 races observed).
render.tilesManifestInvocation:
emit win311 \
  --tile win311 --vmid 90 --udp 54090 --pointer warpd \
  --warpd-addr unix:/data/vms/streamhost/tiles/win311/serial.sock \
  --warpd-buttons qemu --warpd-pace-ms 8 --warpd-button-delay-ms 80 \
  --audio on --fps 30 \
  --launcher-file "$T/win311/qemu-streamhost.sh" \
  --env-append-file "$T/win311/tile.env.fixture"
